note: One entry per upstream commit after fork_point. status: ported | skipped | deferred | superseded. Keys: upstream_sha (7+ hex prefix), upstream_subject, status, fork_commit (our commit short-sha when ported, else null), reason (one line), decided (YYYY-MM-DD). An upstream commit with no entry is UNCLASSIFIED and reported by `python3 ci/script/fork_audit.py --ports`.
